name: icp-mcp-local
description: Questions and actions across ICP apps by chatting through AI, from a server running on your own machine.
long_description: Runs the Internet Computer MCP server locally. It reads Internet Computer apps and canisters, and — once you sign in with Internet Identity in your browser — acts as your identity at the apps you choose. Treat it like a wallet: whatever drives it acts as you, within the access level and lifetime you grant on Internet Identity's consent screen.
